## Identity stack (read me)

**Character LoRA** — bypassed. Un-bypass (Ctrl+B) and set
`emma_ltx23_v1.safetensors` @ **0.85** once the LTX-2.3 LoRA is
trained. Your Wan `F1scher Wan Lora_*_{high,low}_noise` files do
**NOT** work here — different architecture.

**IC-LoRA Ingredients** — bypassed. Only enable for the A/B test.
It was trained at **768x448 landscape / 121f / 24fps**, so 1088x1920
is out of distribution. If you enable it you must also switch the
prompt to the two-part form:
`Reference sheet: ... / Generated video: ...`
and feed a reference-sheet image instead of a single portrait.

Never run both LoRAs above 1.0 at the same time.

## Temporal upscaler — EXPERIMENTAL, bypassed

Doubles 24 -> 48 fps **in latent space**, which avoids the ghosting
RIFE produces around fast hands and hair.

To enable: select BOTH blue nodes above and press Ctrl+B.

**You must also change the fps math**, or the clip plays at half
speed: find the `ComfyMathExpression` feeding `CreateVideo.fps`
(expression `a`) and change it to `a*2`.

Untested — if it errors or the motion looks wrong, Ctrl+B both
nodes again to disable and nothing else changes.

A woman is speaking to camera. Below is a transcript of exactly what she says, followed by the setting.

Describe her physical performance while she speaks these specific words: her hand gestures, facial expression, head movement and posture, and how they shift as her meaning shifts. Choose gestures that fit the meaning of what she is actually saying. Do not invent different words for her to say. Do not quote or write out her words. Do not mention text, captions, subtitles or writing of any kind.

HER PERFORMANCE STYLE — choreograph strictly in this movement vocabulary: her head is never still — quick lively tilts and turns, chin dips with a look up through her lashes — and her eyes snap straight back to the lens every time: she holds direct eye contact with the camera almost constantly. The face carries the story: big genuine smiles breaking into laughs, playful pouts between phrases, eyes widening on emphasis while staying locked on the camera. A hand rises into frame only occasionally as a quick accent — a finger point, a palm flat to the chest, counting on fingers — then settles away. Shoulders relaxed with a subtle shimmy on sassy lines; she leans slightly toward the camera to confide. Her chest is in constant heavy motion — pronounced bouncing and jiggling with every laugh, gesture, shimmy and breath. Favor choreography that keeps her torso moving: laughing beats, little seat bounces, shoulder shimmies, leans in and back. Everything runs at a quick energetic tempo — snappy movements, fast reactions, never slow or dreamy. Overall energy: playful, flirty, like gossiping with her best friend.

Write ONE paragraph of at most 90 words. Output only that paragraph, nothing else. Never write any of her words inside quotation marks.

## LTX-2.3 Prompting Tips

1. **Core Actions**: Describe events and actions as they occur over time  
2. **Visual Details**: Describe all visual details you want to appear in the video  
3. **Audio**: Describe sounds and dialogue needed for the scene
